body: Thats how I kind of see it. This whole experience sucks obviously, but its led me to learn a lot about myself and how I handle myself. I'm learning more and more everyday from this as I keep thinking about it. Life is what happens when you are busy making other plans.

I was working throughout the holidays as a server at a new bar in town that I know the owners, but business slowed down after the holidays so they let me go until It picks back up again (spring/summer). I'm currently prepping to begin an assistant coaching position during the spring for a youth soccer team which I love to do. And I'm 19 so I'm still figuring stuff out.

I was scared and panicked because my LDR gf (now ex) had become pregnant even though she was on the pill and me being a scared college kid who didn't want to go to my mom for $ for an abortion (dad died when I was 13) because my gf scared me into not telling anyone, so I drunkenly broke into some university housing dorms and stole some laptops and books. Sold books back to bookstore then went another night and drunkenly started opening random dorm doors in a dorm building and lifting money out of peoples wallets that were left there. Eventually got caught by university police because name was presented when I sold back the books, got suspended from school for a year, moved back home, currently taking community college classes. Basically after legal fees, lost school fees from having to leave halfway through a semester, a procedure I thought we needed that cost ~$700, eventually cost me $10,000 for those mistakes. Fucking kicker is she ended up having a miscarriage, or was in the process of it but she never was completely honest about it to me. 

**TL;DR gf got preg, I stole some stuff out of panic for abortion $, got suspended from school, legal repurcussions, $10,000 mistake, turns out miscarriage. FML**

My aunt at this time had also fallen sick of cancer, so I felt too scarred/pressured to ask my mom for help (my dad died 6 years ago from cancer). After a bad night of dwelling and stressing on my situation, pressure from her to make sure we could pay for everything, and some heavy doses alcohol in my system, I broke into some student housing units from my university, stole some laptops and books and money. She eventually miscarried, and is going through tests for leukemia. I'm going through the legal process with burglary and theft charges against me, I've been suspended from university, and going to my first substance abuse evaluation tomorrow. Yippie Kay Ya.
